The '''Tarsa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tarsa]] and its moon [[Alessia]].
